Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precau- tions As for Atropine Sulfate, p.1219. Animal studies have shown reproductive toxicity with high doses of oxybutynin, hence the recommendation that it should be avoided during pregnancy; caution should also be observed during breast feeding. Effects on body temperature. A 76-year-old man taking oxy- butynin hydrochloride 5 mg three times daily suffered heatstroke on a day when the ambient temperature was about 37°.
